name: Njorun's Will
summary: Njorun's Will is a 2-player co-op action-adventure fantasy game. Invite a friend to incarnate a pair of Kæra Scouts embarked on a dangerous investigation mission in the Vestmar kingdom.

name: Njuma
summary: Njuma is a 2D narrative driven pixel game with multiple endings. Be the difference your family needs as they draw their final breath.

name: Njoy
summary: Njoy is an interactive live-stream party game for TikTok, Twitch and Kick. The streamer runs it from njoyg.com and viewers play straight from the live chat: they join with one word, answer quizzes and speed challenges, and play party games like Musical Chairs, Tug of War, Hex Fall and Cowboy duels, with points, a leaderboard and a winner on screen. Made for Arabic-speaking streamers and their communities.
